questionLoadXBRLQuestion.label: How do I upload a file to generate the XBRL?
questionLoadXBRLAnswer.label:
Via the button located above the main table on the home page.
You can click the button and select the file, or drag the file onto the button area, which starts the full XBRL Lite flow.
Excel files must follow this naming: [Entity]_[Module]_[Domain]_[YYYYMM]_[Additional_information].xlsx
questionLoadImportLogsQuestion.label: How do I view the import process messages in XBRL Lite?
questionLoadImportLogsAnswer.label:
By clicking the button in the third-from-last column of the main table on the home page, on the row of the module you want to view.
To close the table containing the import process messages, click the same button again.
questionLoadValidatedRulesQuestion.label: How do I view the validated rules in XBRL Lite?
questionLoadValidatedRulesAnswer.label:
By clicking the button in the second-to-last column of the main table on the home page, on the row of the module you want to view.
To close the table containing the validation rules, click the same button again.
questionLoadGenerationLogsQuestion.label: How do I view the generation process messages in XBRL Lite?
questionLoadGenerationLogsAnswer.label:
By clicking the button in the last column of the main table on the home page, on the row of the module you want to view.
To close the table containing the generation process messages, click the same button again.
questionLoadFilterModuleMainTableQuestio: How do I filter the modules on the home page by a specific module?
In the filter bar above the main table on the home page there is a button named “Module”.
Clicking that button and selecting the module you want to filter will make the main table show the runs executed with that module.
questionLoadFilterReferenceDateMainTable: How do I filter the modules on the home page by a specific reference date?

In the filter bar above the main table on the home page there are buttons named “Year” and “Month”.
Clicking the “Year” button and selecting the year you want to filter will show in the main table the runs where the reference date has the selected year.
Clicking the “Month” button and selecting the month you want to filter will show in the main table the runs where the reference date has the selected month.
Filtering by both year and month will show runs where the reference date has the selected year and month.
questionLoadCaptionIconsMainTableQuestio: What do the symbols in the first 3 columns (Import Status, Validation Status, and Generation Status) mean?
questionLoadChangeLanguageQuestion.label: How can I change XBRL Lite’s language?
questionLoadChangeLanguageAnswer.label:
In the top-right corner there is a button with the current language selected.
To change the language, click the button and select the language you want.
questionLoadPermitedFilesQuestion.label: Which documents should I use to generate the XBRL?
questionLoadPermitedFilesAnswer.label: The documents must follow the EBA taxonomy / templates that comply with the Implementing Technical Standards (ITS).
questionLoadDownloadTemplatesPageQuestio: Where can I download empty templates to generate the XBRL?
If you don’t have an empty template that complies with the Implementing Technical Standards (ITS), you can download one in XBRL Lite.
In the top-right corner there is a button named “Usage Templates”, to the left of XBRL Lite’s language button.
Clicking that button redirects you to a page with a table listing all templates available to download.
questionLoadFilterModuleTemplateTableQue: How do I filter templates on the “Usage Templates” page by a specific module?
questionLoadFilterModuleTemplateTableAns:
In the filter bar above the main table on the page containing the usage templates there is a button named “All Modules”.
Clicking that button and selecting the module you want to filter will make the main table show the templates available to download for that module.
You can apply multiple filters at the same time, filtering by module, reference date, and version.
questionLoadFilterBeginDateTemplateTable: How do I filter templates on the “Usage Templates” page by a specific date?

In the filter bar above the main table on the page containing the usage templates there are buttons named “Year” and “Month”.
Clicking the “Year” button and selecting the year you want to filter will show in the main table the templates available to download whose start date has the selected year.
Clicking the “Month” button and selecting the month you want to filter will show in the main table the templates available to download whose start date has the selected month.
You can apply multiple filters at the same time, filtering by module, reference date, and version.
questionLoadFilterVersionTemplateTableQu: How do I filter templates on the “Usage Templates” page by a specific version?
questionLoadFilterVersionTemplateTableAn:
In the filter bar above the main table on the page containing the usage templates there is a button named “Version”.
Clicking that button and selecting the version you want to filter will show in the main table the templates available to download with that version.
You can apply multiple filters at the same time, filtering by module, reference date, and version.
questionLoadDownloadTemplateButtonQuesti: How do I download the template I want?
questionLoadDownloadTemplateButtonAnswer: By clicking the button in the last column of the main table on the page containing the usage templates, on the row of the template you want to download; it will automatically download to the user’s machine.
questionLoadReturnMainPageQuestion.label: I went to the “Usage Templates” page and I want to go back to the home page—how?
questionLoadReturnMainPageAnswer.label: By clicking the Neyond logo in the top-left corner.
